title: Project Color Beacons
summary: Mark each project with a color, name, and symbol before you edit.
user: Dyslexic and ADHD developers juggling several similar windows who need an immediate non-text cue for which project they are about to edit.
smallest_useful_product: A local desktop helper plus editor configs that assigns a stable high-contrast color/name/icon beacon per project root and shows a confirmation strip before focus-sensitive actions.
success_measure: In a multi-project task test, participants reduce wrong-window edits by 50% compared with identical-window baseline.
constraints: Color cannot be the sole cue; include text/icon alternatives and color-blind palettes; project paths remain local; integrations must use supported editor APIs.
